newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Electric stake cut FMR group.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Electric stake cut FMR group.

text.p: A group led by FMR Corp, parent of investment advisor Fidleity Management & Research Co, said Monday it reduced its stake in El Paso Electric Co to 20.98 percent or 12,590,339 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Comission, the group said it sold a net of 1,240,996 common shares between October 24 and December 9.
Transactions included the sale of 3,056,596 shares at prices ranging from $5.125 to $6.4524 a share and the purchase of 1,815,600 shares on November 18 at $5.4375 a share, it said.
Boston-based Fidelity Management is investment adviser to Fidelity Funds, the nation's largest mutual fund group.
